summary: Ohmyhome Ltd filed a routine 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, furnishing interim financial statements for the period ended June 30, 2026. The XBRL-tagged disclosure covers Q2 and first-half results, segment and geographic revenue, equity incentive plans, supplier concentration and discontinued operations, plus subsequent-event notes referencing a July 17, 2026 warrant/Class A transaction and a July 21, 2026 reverse stock split. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation or advisor is described, so no special-situation deal terms apply. Watch the reverse split and warrant activity for dilution and listing-compliance effects rather than deal arbitrage.
